Articulate Game Voiceover

Another tv advert for another great kids' toy

Smyths Toys Voice

I provided voiceover for an TV ad for the kids' edition of Articulate, one of the most popular board games in the World. Over the years, I've provided voiceover for lots of toy commercials, including plenty of ads for Smyths Toys.
I have lots of experience working with toy companies and my voice is used by some major toy brands worldwide, which makes me really proud. I can bring warmth and energy to the script and add that little bit of sparkle to your campaign.
The toy industry is a big part of my workload and it's just as fun as it sounds. Please feel free to check out some of my other work to see if my voice is right for your toy, game, promo or brand.

What is Articulate?

Articulate is the fast-talking description game for kids with between 4 and 20 players. Describe as many things on the cards as possible to your teammates in 30 seconds without giving "begins with" or "sounds like" clues. Sound easy? Well, that depends on who you're teamed-up with! Articulate is all about finding the quickest, easiest way to describe something to your teammates and it's so much fun.
Articulate for Kids follows on from the spectacularly successful adult description game and can now be played by kids as young as 6 and as old as 12. It's great when a game mechanic works so well that it translates perfectly to different audiences! Articulate is the perfect family game to play at Christmas and it was a lot of fun to work on the TV ad!

Looking for a voice with energy and fun?

As you can tell from my website, I love voicing these kinds of jobs. And as my daughter gets a little older, there's a really good chance she'll hear my work (I wonder if she'll recognise me?). My vocal tone is bright, happy, and quirky, which is seems to be a perfect match for toys and board game commercials! If you'd like a little help figuring out whether my voice is right for your project, please feel free to get in touch and ask me to provide a sample of your script.
